name: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Using Qiskit quantum_info, prepare the state
task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Using Qiskit quantum_info, prepare the state RY(0.811) on qubit 0 followed by CX(0,1), compute the reduced density matrix of qubit 0 via partial trace, and print its von Neumann entanglement entropy (base 2). Give one complete script that runs end-to-end on its own and prints the outcome.
